ethereum.name: Ethereum
ethereum.headline: Ethereum, in your wallet.
ethereum.intro: Receive, send and manage assets on Ethereum with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
ethereum.receive: Use Ethereum mainnet for this account. ETH on another network must be received on that network instead.
ethereum.send: Keep ETH available for network fees. For tokens, check the contract and amount, then review the destination and estimated fee in Oath.
ethereum.connection: Connect to compatible Ethereum dApps through WalletConnect. The website must request a network and signing method supported by Oath. Review every connection and signing request in the app.

solana.name: Solana
solana.headline: Solana, without the noise.
solana.intro: Keep SOL and supported Solana tokens together, with receiving, sending and compatible dApp connections.
solana.receive: Use the Solana address in Receive. Match a token by its mint and network, not its symbol alone.
solana.send: Keep SOL for fees and any required token-account creation. Review the fee and remaining balance before confirming.
solana.connection: Connect to compatible Solana dApps through WalletConnect. The website must request a network and signing method supported by Oath. Review every connection and signing request in the app. A website that only detects browser extensions may not offer a compatible mobile connection.

ton.name: Gram
ton.headline: Gram, in your wallet.
ton.intro: Send and receive Gram on iPhone and iPad with Oath Wallet. Gram (GRAM) is the native coin of the TON blockchain, formerly called Toncoin.
ton.receive: Choose Gram in Receive and share the TON address shown in Oath. Confirm the sender supports the address format and add a comment if the receiving service requires one.
ton.send: Keep Gram for network fees and any wallet-contract activation. For a jetton, check its master contract; a token named GRAM is not necessarily the native coin.
ton.connection: Connect to compatible Gram dApps through WalletConnect. The website must request a network and signing method supported by Oath. Review every connection and signing request in the app. WalletConnect and TON Connect are different protocols. This guide does not claim TON Connect support.
